ko.description: 미국 현지 고객들이 직접 작성한 별 5개 리얼 리뷰

reviews.title: 아마존보다 저렴하고 독점 상품도 많아요
reviews.review: 아마존/Weee보다 확실히 저렴해서 좋았어요. 프로틴바, 닥터지 스캘프 샴푸처럼 타 플랫폼엔 없는 제품도 있고, 메디힐 같은 화장품 브랜드는 할인폭도 커서 매력적이에요.

reviews.title: 무료배송 기준이 확실히 경쟁력 있어요
reviews.review: 무료배송 기준이 $49라 타 플랫폼보다 경쟁력 있어요. 여러 아시아 국가 식품을 한 곳에서 살 수 있는 것도 큰 장점입니다.

reviews.title: Fast delivery, exactly what I wanted
reviews.review: I was skeptical at first, but the welcome discount plus new year sale made it worth trying. My package arrived in just a few days, and everything was exactly what I was looking for. Highly recommend!

reviews.title: Finally found my favorite Asian snacks
reviews.review: I generally love this app, as it makes some of my favorite Asian snacks and drinks available now that I moved away from H-Mart.

reviews.title: Fair prices, fast shipping
reviews.review: Fair prices and very fast shipping. Great for people that love trying new foods.

reviews.title: Delivery is amazingly fast
reviews.review: One of my favorite Asian shop apps — delivery took only a day or two for me, and the snacks and skincare items are truly one of a kind. Great for gifts too!

reviews.title: A dependable way to get Asian food
reviews.review: I can't buy certain Asian food items where I live — being able to order online with a dependable company is great. Highly recommend!

reviews.title: Great variety, packed well
reviews.review: App has a great variety of stuff, packs items well, and shipping is very quick!

reviews.title: Half the price of other apps
reviews.review: I love this app so much I tell everyone about it! My favorite ramen is half the price of other shopping apps, and there are tons of options to choose from. Highly recommend!
